therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: T-cell exhaustion reversal and anti-tumor immune response enhancement

results.effect_size: 8/11 alive in nivolumab arm vs 4/4 alive in control arm at study termination
biomarker_changes: PD-L1 CPS and TPS scores collected for biomarker analysis
subgroup_findings: PFS by PD-L1 CPS and TPS planned but not reported due to early termination
safety_signals: Grade 3+ AEs: 10/11 nivolumab arm vs 2/4 control arm
results.dose_information: Nivolumab given IV, gemcitabine given IV, cisplatin or carboplatin given IV, 21-day cycles

context.investigator_commentary: Study terminated early due to poor accrual - planned for 200 deaths but only enrolled 15 participants
